Comment 0 (2012-12-13): // Options: --externs externs/es3.js --property_renaming OFF --variable_renaming OFF --jscomp_warning=checkTypes --js=t.js // File: t.js /** * @interface */ var OtherType = function() {} /** * @implements {MyType} * @constructor */ var MyType = function() {} /** * @type {MyType} */ var x = /** @type {!OtherType} */ (new Object()); Get Infinite recursion in: PrototypeObjectType.isSubtype @ 350 Options: - prevent cycles in the inheritance/implements graph - detect cycles after they are created and exit compilation before any subsequent passes run - detect and remove cycles after they are created but before any subsequent passes run - make every subsequent pass robust against cycles in that graph
